hook: CM wants *3* PRTS corridors tendered by December
hook_b: CM wants *3* PRTS corridors tendered by December
tldr: Revanth Reddy asked officials to prepare Personal Rapid Transit System corridors across central Hyderabad and the IT corridor to ease traffic.

beats.what: Corridors: LB Stadium to Ranigunj via Tank Bund; Assembly Metro to Begumpet via Secretariat; KPHB Metro to Biodiversity via Durgam Cheruvu and Mindspace, per TOI.
beats.why: The CM said the aim is to improve urban mobility and cut congestion, with speedy execution.
beats.care: If built, the IT-corridor line would link KPHB, Madhapur and Gachibowli metro stations.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: He set a deadline to finish tendering by December and complete corridors within a year of work starting.

facts.t: The CM wants corridors finished *within one year* of work commencing.

viz.verdict: A plan for now; timelines depend on tenders

learn.t: PRTS = Personal Rapid Transit System, the new transit mode proposed for these corridors

watch: Whether tenders are floated by December as the CM directed.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Reduce traffic woes, boost healthcare infrastructure: CM to officials

fact: CM orders *three* PRTS corridors, tenders by December, built within a year.
twist: Multi-level parking with PRTS depots is planned at *Necklace Road* and near *IKEA, Gachibowli*.
